$comment: Where the vendored catalog.json came from, and — when it leads the published engine — why that is allowed. `sync-catalog.mjs --check` enforces every claim in this file, in both directions: an unexplained difference fails, and so does an `aheadOfPublished` marker that the publish has since caught up with.
why: LEADS @paged-media/introspect-wasm@0.73.4 (from protocol 74 the ./introspect entry of @paged-media/canvas-wasm, PM-0008) by design: protocol 74 (tracked deletions accepted and rejected, engine ADR 184, monorepo commit 524b08ea4) is in the tree and not yet published. First-party packages take the engine from the workspace (`workspace:*`), so this copy follows engine/core/crates/paged-introspect/catalog.json, which `sync-catalog.mjs --check` compares it with. Prior: in sync as of introspect-wasm@0.73.4 (core@8eb9e21, protocol 73).
